description: This file defines the InMemoryTransportConnection class, which manages in-memory transport connections for testing Orleans. It handles connection creation, closure, and disposal, and manages related Pipe and networking resources.

classes.name: InMemoryTransportConnection
classes.description: Represents an in-memory transport connection for Orleans testing, managing connection lifecycle, pipes, and endpoints.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new in-memory transport connection with specified memory pool, logger, and endpoints.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a reverse in-memory transport connection, swapping application and transport pipes.

methods.name: Abort
methods.description: Aborts the connection, logging the reason and cancelling pending operations.

methods.name: OnClosed
methods.description: Marks the connection as closed, triggers cleanup and signals completion.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes of the connection, ensuring proper cleanup.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the connection endpoint information.
